%         UTXO set, runs the other consensus checks and schedules work (pushes per-input
%         capacity down).  The net is UNQUANTIFIED here -- assert neither direction.
%   (iii) NOT error-barred.  The reciprocal of a mean is not the mean of a rate, so the
%         measured SD does not transform linearly.  Quote no +/- on it.
